literal_meaning: নাচের তাল বা লাফানোর শব্দানুকরণ (onomatopoeic sounds of rhythmic dancing or jumping)
figurative_meaning_en: dancing and jumping around, frolicking noisily
example_sentences_in_bangla: পার্টিতে সবাই ধিন-তা-ধিনা করে নাচতে শুরু করল।
example_sentences_in_english: The children are dhina-tadhina-ing around in the yard.
Everyone started dancing and jumping around at the party.
note: This idiom mimics the sounds of traditional Bengali folk dances or playful movements.
